narr: An anomalously moist airmass with tropical moisture resided over much of Virginia on July 16th. This comes after several days of showers and thunderstorms, which left some areas with suppressed flash flood guidance. Slow moving thunderstorms developed on remnant boundaries and terrain circulations before propagating eastward. These storms produced localized rainfall amounts of two to five inches.
ev: Orkney Springs Road closed due to Rinker Run flowing across the road. Fire dept estimated depth of 1-2 feet.
Old Tavern Road blocked at Great Meadows due to high water.
James Madison Highway closed in both directions due to high water near 5222 James Madison Highway near Warrenton.
Swift water rescue on Glenkirk Road. Vehicle disabled with at least 6 inches of water over the bridge just downstream of Lake Manassas Dam.
Gooney Run reported to be flowing well out of its banks surrounding houses on Browntown Road. Basements flooded. Pets trapped.
Little Bull Run rose rapidly above minor flood stage in less than an hour. At this level, Artemus Road is flooded.
Balls Mill Road closed. Reported to be at least one foot of water flowing across the road near Moopack Lane.
Blantyre Road closed due to multiple small creeks flowing across the road. Several cars stalled out. Water estimated 2-4 feet deep in spots.
Truck swept away by high rushing water on St Leonards Lane. Swift water rescue ongoing.
Numerous water rescues ongoing on Springs Road. Water reported to be up to 7 to 8 feet deep near the creek on Woodbourne Lane.
Kettle Run rose rapidly above minor flood stage. At this level, a foot of water is flowing across Valley View Drive.
